text:
[Council File 17-0274-S3]
Motion (Blumenfield - Hutt) relative to refunding the Affordable Housing Linkage Fee for an incomplete construction project where a Certificate of Occupancy is never obtained.
(Also referred to Planning and Land Use Management Committee.)
Community Impact Statement:
Yes
For if Amended: Palms Neighborhood Council

outcome.text: Planning and Land Use Management Committee concurred with the recommendation of the Housing Committee (Sep 22, 2026); Council adopted item, subject to reconsideration, pursuant to Council Rule 51 (Oct 6, 2026); Council action final

summary: Motion to refund the Affordable Housing Linkage Fee for a construction project that was never completed and never received a Certificate of Occupancy.
